findings.issue: The --extend row tells the reader to 'pass `--convergence-mode=off` or use `stopPolicy: max-iterations`' to stop an extension from re-stopping on all_dimensions_clean. Neither works on an extended run. This is the same defect as L3-1 in another doc. step_extend_completed_run (deep-review.yaml:568-575) writes the config back with only status, maxIterations, maxDurationMinutes, lineageMode and continuedFromRun changed. antiConvergence.convergenceMode and stopPolicy are written only by step_create_config (deep-review.yaml:880, 888), which an extension never runs. The loop reads both values back from the config (deep-review.yaml:1177-1178) and passes that convergence_mode to convergence.cjs (line 1245), so the --convergence-mode flag never reaches the stop decision. The NEVER rule at deep-review.yaml:2612 forbids editing the config by hand.

880: antiConvergence.convergenceMode: "{convergence_mode}"
888: stopPolicy: "{stop_policy}"
1177: - stop_policy: "Extract stopPolicy from deep-review-config.json ..."
1178: - convergence_mode: "Extract antiConvergence.convergenceMode ..."

findings.issue: The research extension warning has the same defect as L3-1, and L2 did not report it. It says 'Pass --convergence-mode=off, use stopPolicy max-iterations, or add questions to research/inbox.jsonl'. The extension step builds the new config at lines 545-551 and changes only status, maxIterations, maxDurationMinutes and the lineage fields. antiConvergence.convergenceMode and stopPolicy are written only by the config-creation step (lines 726-727). The loop reads both values from the config (lines 1112 and 1114, and line 856), so --convergence-mode=off given with --extend never takes effect. Of the three options, only adding inbox questions works.

The first two cannot take effect on an extended run, because the extension step never writes antiConvergence.convergenceMode or stopPolicy and the loop reads both from the config (deep-research.yaml:545-551, 726-727, 1112, 1114). The --depth-mode row says the seed prunes all merges ('merges are pruned as `merge-no-own-diff`'). L6-1 found the same error in the review catalog, and L4 did not report it here. The seed step marks only a merge commit with no diff of its own, and only on a commit-range target (deep-review.yaml:330-334). deep-review SKILL.md:238 states this correctly, so the two docs contradict each other.
